title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
text:
research area Computer Visioncontent type paperpublished November 2026Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular DepthAuthorsPeiyun Hu, Marko Mihajlovic, Lyndon Duong, Lahav Lipson, Wei Dong, Amaël Delaunoy, Stephan R. Richter, Vladlen KoltunView publicationView source code (GitHub)We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime.
We release code and weights here.
Depth Pro 2 estimates the depth of every pixel, in meters, from images taken with an ordinary camera. One network handles a single photo, a whole video, or a live camera feed, at the input’s full resolution. Its depth is sharp at object edges and steady from frame to frame.December 13, 2025research area Computer Vision, research area Methods and Algorithmsconference ICLRWe present SHARP, an approach to photorealistic view synthesis from a single image.
